description.value: Haida Sandwich is a halal-certified sandwich and pizza chain with a North Vancouver location serving massive subs, oven-roasted hot sandwiches, and fully loaded pizzas. The restaurant has been serving the halal community for over eight years with large portions and a broad menu spanning cold-cut and grilled options. Catering for corporate and private events is also available, making it a useful fuel stop for cyclists wanting a substantial, customizable meal.
